blocks.content: Let's first revise the working of a function with an example.
In the above program, we have created an add_numbers() function that

items: takes two parameters, n1 and n2 (input)

blocks.content: Like regular variables (n1 and n2), we can also pass structs as arguments to functions.
In this lesson, we will learn to

items: create a function inside a struct
pass a struct to a function
return a struct from a function
